  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "7dbed13b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# GLANCE: Cross-dataset integration of single-cell proteomics\n",
    "\n",
    "This tutorial demonstrates **cross-dataset integration** of single-cell mass spectrometry proteomics data with GLANCE, followed by UMAP visualization before and after integration.\n",
    "\n",
    "The processed data and annotations are available from the Slavov Lab:\n",
    "\n",
    "- [Leduc et al. dataset](https://scp.slavovlab.net/Leduc_et_al_2022)\n",
    "- [Derks et al. dataset](https://scp.slavovlab.net/Derks_et_al_2022)\n",
    "\n",
    "**References:**\n",
    "\n",
    "- Leduc A, Huffman RG, Cantlon J, Khan S, Slavov N. *Exploring functional protein covariation across single cells using nPOP*. *Genome Biology* **23**, 261 (2022). [doi:10.1186/s13059-022-02817-5](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-022-02817-5).\n",
    "- Derks J, Leduc A, Wallmann G, et al. *Increasing the throughput of sensitive proteomics by plexDIA*. *Nature Biotechnology* (2022). [doi:10.1038/s41587-022-01389-w](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-022-01389-w)."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "864a79f4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 1. Setup\n",
    "\n",
    "The example uses `glancevae`, `scanpy`, `anndata`, `pandas`, and PyTorch. PyTorch runs on a CUDA GPU when available and otherwise uses the CPU."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "96d64826",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Global seed set to 2026 (deterministic=True)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import warnings\n",
    "from tqdm.std import TqdmWarning\n",
    "\n",
    "# Silence an optional Jupyter progress-bar warning.\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings(\n",
    "    \"ignore\",\n",
    "    message=r\"IProgress not found.*\",\n",
    "    category=TqdmWarning,\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "import scanpy as sc\n",
    "import anndata as ad\n",
    "\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "from glancevae import seed_everything, GLANCE\n",
    "\n",
    "SEED = 2026\n",
    "seed_everything(SEED)\n",
    "sc.settings.seed = SEED"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "7d7ea929",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 2. Load and preprocess data\n",
    "\n",
    "Place the downloaded files in `./data/Leduc2022/` and `./data/Derks2023/`, as specified below. Each abundance matrix is transposed into **cells × proteins** orientation.\n",
    "\n",
    "The datasets use different cell-type labels and batch annotations. These are harmonized before concatenation; only proteins shared by both datasets are retained (`join=\"inner\"`)."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "a152f997",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Leduc2022 files\n",
    "DATASET1_PATH = Path(\"./data/Leduc2022/\")\n",
    "SC_MATRIX1_PATH = DATASET1_PATH / \"t6.csv\"\n",
    "META1_PATH = DATASET1_PATH / \"meta.csv\"\n",
    "\n",
    "# Derks2023 files\n",
    "DATASET2_PATH = Path(\"./data/Derks2023/\")\n",
    "SC_MATRIX2_PATH = DATASET2_PATH / \"Proteins_SC_IDs.txt\"\n",
    "META2_PATH = DATASET2_PATH / \"Meta_SingleCell_updated_1.tsv\""
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "725f7552",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Leduc2022\n",
    "\n",
    "Read the abundance matrix and metadata, and harmonize the cell-type labels. Batch IDs retain their Leduc2022-specific prefix."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "c8faf1f2",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "raw_df1 = pd.read_csv(SC_MATRIX1_PATH, index_col=0)\n",
    "metadata_df1 = pd.read_csv(META1_PATH, index_col=\"id\")\n",
    "\n",
    "abundance_df1 = raw_df1.T\n",
    "cell_ids1 = abundance_df1.index\n",
    "\n",
    "cell_type_map1 = {\n",
    "    cid: (\"Melanoma\" if value == \"m\" else \"Monocyte\")\n",
    "    for cid, value in metadata_df1[\"celltype\"].items()\n",
    "}\n",
    "batch_map1 = {\n",
    "    cid: f\"Leduc2022_{value}\"\n",
    "    for cid, value in metadata_df1[\"lcbatch\"].items()\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "obs1 = pd.DataFrame(\n",
    "    {\n",
    "        \"cell_type\": [cell_type_map1[cid] for cid in cell_ids1],\n",
    "        \"batch\": [batch_map1[cid] for cid in cell_ids1],\n",
    "    },\n",
    "    index=cell_ids1,\n",
    ")\n",
    "var1 = pd.DataFrame(index=abundance_df1.columns)\n",
    "\n",
    "adata1 = ad.AnnData(X=abundance_df1.values, obs=obs1, var=var1)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "035e200c",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Derks2023\n",
    "\n",
    "Read the second dataset and harmonize its cell-type labels. The original analysis treats these cells as a single batch (`Derks2023`)."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "8c6d8465",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "raw_df2 = pd.read_csv(SC_MATRIX2_PATH, index_col=0, delimiter=\"\\t\")\n",
    "metadata_df2 = pd.read_csv(META2_PATH, index_col=\"id\", delimiter=\"\\t\")\n",
    "\n",
    "abundance_df2 = raw_df2.T\n",
    "cell_ids2 = abundance_df2.index\n",
    "\n",
    "cell_type_map2 = {\n",
    "    cid: (\"Monocyte\" if value[:5] == \"U-937\" else value)\n",
    "    for cid, value in metadata_df2[\"Celltype\"].items()\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "obs2 = pd.DataFrame(\n",
    "    {\n",
    "        \"cell_type\": [\n",
    "            cell_type_map2[cid].replace(\"_t\", \"\").replace(\"_DB\", \"\")\n",
    "            for cid in cell_ids2\n",
    "        ],\n",
    "        \"batch\": [\"Derks2023\"] * len(cell_ids2),\n",
    "    },\n",
    "    index=cell_ids2,\n",
    ")\n",
    "var2 = pd.DataFrame(index=abundance_df2.columns)\n",
    "\n",
    "adata2 = ad.AnnData(X=abundance_df2.values, obs=obs2, var=var2)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "52edd3c1",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Combine datasets\n",
    "\n",
    "Concatenate both datasets using their shared proteins, add a `source` annotation, and scale the abundance matrix."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "241b1a8c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "adata = ad.concat(\n",
    "    [adata1, adata2],\n",
    "    axis=0,\n",
    "    join=\"inner\",\n",
    "    label=\"source\",\n",
    "    keys=[\"Leduc2022\", \"Derks2023\"],\n",
    "    index_unique=\"-\",\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "sc.pp.scale(adata, max_value=10)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4fb40299",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Input abundance visualization\n",
    "\n",
    "UMAP of the scaled input abundance matrix (`adata.X`), colored by cell type, batch, and dataset source."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "0b3481c4",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 2496x480 with 3 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "sc.pp.neighbors(adata, use_rep=\"X\")\n",
    "sc.tl.umap(adata)\n",
    "sc.pl.umap(\n",
    "    adata,\n",
    "    color=[\"cell_type\", \"batch\", \"source\"],\n",
    "    wspace=0.3,\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a88af1c6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 3. Integrate cells with GLANCE\n",
    "\n",
    "Fit GLANCE using the `batch` annotation. The integrated representation is stored in `adata.obsm[\"GLANCE\"]`."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "8a72d09f",

      "\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "device = torch.device(\"cuda:0\" if torch.cuda.is_available() else \"cpu\")\n",
    "\n",
    "model = GLANCE(adata=adata, label_col=\"batch\", random_state=SEED, device=device)\n",
    "\n",
    "model.prepare_local_manifold()\n",
    "model.prepare_geom_refinement()\n",
    "model.fit_transform()"
   ]
  },
